T1_presheaf_restrictions.statement: Edge-to-vertex restriction maps are well-defined and compatible on incidence.

T2_local_compatibility.statement: Compatible local edge sections are exactly those agreeing on shared vertices.

T3_independent_global_state.statement: If R123 contains an independent global variable invisible to the edge cover, each compatible edge family has multiple global extensions; the sheaf uniqueness axiom fails.

T4_derived_global_state.statement: If the whole-system state is determined by compatible local data through a declared gluing law, each compatible edge family has a unique global extension.

T5_bandwidth_subobject.statement: Bandwidth can restrict the admissible global sections/transport moves without changing the underlying restriction maps.

T6_rainbow_road_action.statement: Portal moves can be modeled as partial morphisms between admissible global sections; Road is their composable History-bearing path.
